title: Rethinking Healthcare for the Future
content:
Healthcare systems worldwide are facing structural pressures that traditional models were never designed to handle — ageing populations, rising chronic disease, strained workforces, and growing patient expectations. Rethinking what healthcare looks like in the future isn't optional; it's a design challenge of enormous consequence.

This talk, delivered in collaboration with RMIT University, explores how emerging technologies, new service models, and shifts in patient behaviour are converging to create an opportunity to fundamentally redesign how healthcare is delivered.

Key themes

  • What does patient-centred care actually look like when designed from scratch?
  • The role of digital health products in moving from episodic treatment to continuous support
  • How data and AI can shift the system from reactive to preventative
  • What designers and product managers can do today to contribute to healthcare's future

About the talk

Delivered in collaboration with RMIT University.

Speaker: Remko Vermeulen, VP & Head of Product
